intro: Haiti is the poorest country in the Americas.

chapters.title: How it earns
text: Most people farm or work informally. Clothing factories, mangoes, coffee and vetiver oil for perfume are exports. Money sent home from abroad is a large share of income.

chapters.title: Crisis
text: Gang violence has disrupted trade and food supplies.

keyTerms.meaning: A grass whose roots give a perfume oil.

cardGroups.title: Made in Haiti
cardGroups.intro: Some of the things Haiti makes and sells to the world.
